name: upgauge-html-cache
description: Make text/html cacheable at the edge and respect the origin's own Cache-Control (edge_ttl/browser_ttl: respect_origin). Cloudflare's default cache keys off static file extensions, so HTML is not cached at all without this rule -- the app's own HTML_CACHE (public, s-maxage=3600) and /api/pivot's longer TTL both reach an edge that otherwise ignores them.

rules.description: Cache HTML and respect the origin TTL the app already sets
